name: Open Props
summary: Open-source CSS custom properties: 500+ design tokens for colors, gradients, shadows, sizes, easing and animations.
description: A library of sub-atomic design tokens — CSS custom properties for colors (Open Color plus a 16-step dynamic oklch palette), gradients, shadows, aspect ratios, typography, easing, durations, animations, sizes, borders, masks and z-index. Ships as CSS, PostCSS, JSON design tokens, JavaScript or web components from a CDN or npm, with individual prop packs and a CLI for custom bundles.
contains: 500+ props in the 4.0 kB minified bundle
individual prop packs: colors (228), gradients, shadows, easings, animations, sizes, borders, masks, media, fonts
flavors: CSS, PostCSS, JSON design tokens, JavaScript, web components
CDN or npm, plus a CLI for custom bundles
examples: hero layout, adaptive buttons, cards, pagination, light/dark switch
